conflicts.fact: Charge/valency of phosphate (PO₄³⁻ vs HPO₄²⁻) used to derive the DAP formula
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 says phosphate's valency is 2 in (NH₄)₂HPO₄ while listing PO₄³⁻ as the KICD radical. Lesson 6 says HPO₄²⁻ has valency 2. Lesson 8 says phosphate carries a 3- charge, so cross-multiplying gives (NH₄)₃PO₄, not (NH₄)₂HPO₄.

conflicts.fact: Formula for DAP / ammonium phosphate used in the equation practice
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7 balances 3(NH₄)OH + H₃PO₄ → (NH₄)₃PO₄ and its predict task asks whether DAP could be (NH₄)₃PO₄, while its Observe cards use (NH₄)₂HPO₄. Lessons 1, 5, 6 and 8 state DAP is (NH₄)₂HPO₄ with a fixed, unalterable ratio.

Lesson 1 uses the 2.8.8.2 dotted notation. Lessons 2-4 use commas (2,8,8,2). Lesson 1 says the 2-8-8 shell model. Lessons 2 and 3 use Group 15 and Group 5 for nitrogen. Lesson 2 also says Group 15/V and Group 16/VI, while Lesson 4 uses Groups 6 and 7 for non-metals.

conflicts.fact: Outer electron range for metals and non-metals / hydrogen's configuration
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2's Strip A text says hydrogen is '2,1 electrons' (confusing, as H is 1 and Li is 2,1). Lesson 3 says metals have 1–3 outer electrons and reactive non-metals 5–7, a range that conflicts with Lesson 4 stating non-metals are in Groups 6 and 7.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson introduced the cumulative model and which lesson's notes supply the electron configurations
conflicts.versions: Lesson 5 says its table uses configurations 'from Lesson 3' and the ion formation notes are from Lesson 4. Lesson 4 says it revisits Lesson 3 cards, while its Overview says Lesson 2 produced the configurations. Lesson 4's model phase says the model was begun 'revising in Lesson 1'. Lesson 2 says the models began in Lesson 1 for N and Ca, but Lesson 1's model phase had learners choose any three elements.

conflicts.fact: Lesson-count and content of upcoming lessons
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 and Lesson 5 say Lessons 5–8 or 6–8 will cover chemical bonding and equations, but the sequence has no bonding lesson. Lesson 8's overview says 40 minutes while Lessons 6 and 7 are 80 minutes.
